answer.reason: The verses tell of Doeg informing Saul of David's visit to Nob and then slaying the priests at Saul's command; the killing is in the summary only as a relation, so the deed can be told once.

clauses.english: told Saul that David had come to Ahimelech at Nob
clauses.quote: I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

clauses.english: at Saul's command, struck down eighty-five priests who wore a linen ephod
clauses.quote: Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons

doubts: 1SA 22:19 (the smiting of Nob) is not attributed to Doeg by name, so it was left out of the clauses.
